title: Orthogonal replica sandbox and cost controller for safe traffic duplication
creator: Elena Park
description: Build an orthogonal traffic replication pipeline that safely duplicates a bounded fraction of production requests to sandboxed replica pools. The goal is to enable parallel evaluation of candidate models (canary/A-B/shadow) without risking tenant budgets, SLOs, or data contamination. Key capabilities: per-tenant/route credit budgets, adaptive sampling tied to budget health, hard isolation of replica compute and network, non-blocking pass-through, request tagging for deterministic replay, and automatic rollback of replication when cost or error thresholds exceed limits.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Production requests can be duplicated to replica pools at route and tenant granularity with sampling percentages configurable via Console and API.
A2: Each tenant has an enforced replication credit budget; once exhausted, further duplication is blocked and logged.
A3: Replica pools run in network-isolated VPC subnets and cannot reach customer backends or storage.
A4: Replication path is non-blocking: failures in replica path must not add latency to primary responses.
A5: Cost telemetry emitted per-duplication event (tokens, GPU-ms) visible in Console cost breakdowns and billing exporter.
A6: Auto-rollback triggers and alerting exist: replication stops for route when error-rate delta > 1% or spend burn-rate > 2x expected in 5m.
A7: Integration tests for sampling, budget exhaustion, and isolation pass in CI with synthetic load.
A8: Documentation and a runbook are published for SRE and solutions teams.
A9: End-to-end canary use-case demo (new model variant) documented with example Console config and API snippet.
A10: Privacy review confirms no PII is written to persistent replica storage; logs sanitized.

design_decisions: Replica isolation: use dedicated VPC subnets + egress-deny rules so replicas cannot contact customer endpoints; storage disabled by default.
Budgeting: implement token-ms accounting per event and translate to credit units; credits are tenant-scoped and consumable across routes.
Sampling: support fixed percentage sampling plus 'credit-aware' adaptive sampler that reduces sampling as burn approaches budget.
Non-blocking: duplication handled asynchronously by a bounded worker pool; primary path records a replication receipt ID but returns immediately.
Observability: emit replication.trace_id and replication.event metrics; surface in Console cost breakdown and per-route trace views.
Rollback policy: two-tier triggers (soft: alert + slow sampling; hard: pause replication) with exponential cool-down and manual resume.
Security: redact PII using existing pipeline; require security review before enabling replication for tenants with compliance flags.
Testing: include deterministic replay mode (seeded) so replicated requests can be replayed against model variants for offline regression tests.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: runaway replication causing budget exhaustion. Mitigation: hard per-tenant credit caps and circuit-breaker in gateway.
Risk: replica compute impacting shared cluster capacity. Mitigation: dedicated node pools with quota enforcement and autoscale caps.
Risk: latency increase from replication plumbing. Mitigation: fully asynchronous fanout and tight worker queue sizing + backpressure throttles.
Risk: inadvertent data leakage from replicas. Mitigation: strict network policies, no persistent disk by default, and mandatory log redaction.
Risk: complexity in billing reconciliation. Mitigation: emit fine-grained billing events and validate against sandboxed billing pipeline in integration tests.
testing_plan: Unit tests for credit allocator and sampler logic (edge cases: budget boundary, burst requests).
Integration test: synthetic tenant with 10k requests/min, validate sampling adheres to configured percent and credits decrement correctly.
Chaos test: replica pool fails mid-flight; ensure primary latency unaffected and replication errors are logged and aggregated.
Security test: attempt outbound connection from replica pod; must be blocked and logged.
Cost validation: run load in staging and compare billed replication units vs expected; tolerance <5%.
E2E demo: internal canary across three routes with gradual sampling ramp and manual rollback executed.
rollout_plan: Stage 0: Feature behind platform flag; unit tests and code review (ETA 1 week).
Stage 1: Deploy to staging with isolated replica pools; run synthetic load and execute test plan (ETA 2 weeks).
Stage 2: Internal pilot: enable for 3 internal tenants and 2 routes at 1% sampling for 2 weeks; monitor SLOs and cost (ETA 2 weeks).
Stage 3: Customer pilot by invitation only; include billing export verification and runbook handoff (ETA 3 weeks).
Stage 4: GA with Console defaults and recommended budgets; monitor for 1 month intensively (ETA 4 weeks).
metrics_and_dashboards: Replication rate (events/min) per tenant and per-route.
Replication cost per minute and cumulative credit consumption.
Delta in model output quality (regression rate) between primary and replica variants.
Replication error rate and latency of replication path.
Auto-rollback triggers fired and reason codes.
Billing reconciliation anomalies flagged per deployment.

notes: This ticket intentionally diverges from earlier 'mirror' and 'shadow' implementations by focusing on a fully sandboxed replica environment with hard billing boundaries and adaptive sampling tied to explicit credit units.
Follow-on work will include per-model variant weighting, longer-term storage for replay artefacts (opt-in), and tighter integration with Redwood Optimize for automated sampling tuning.
